name: Kohaku
source:
A high-leveled shrine maiden from Cat Kingdom, who was sent to [url=https://vndb.org/c49076]Ibuki[/url]'s world by the Cat God in order to fix discrepancies and to create a balance between the two kingdoms. She's very modest and loves to combine sex with Shinto rituals.

[From Wikipedia]
